title: Elections, Representation & Inclusivity
goal: Voice inclusive democratic commitments with agreeing and past-tense reduplicated subjunctives

items: I can use agreeing sea cual sea / sean cuales sean + noun and open civic verbs in reduplicated subjunctives.
I can shift reduplicated subjunctives into the imperfect subjunctive for past outcomes (fuera cual fuera).
I can use electorate, ballot-count, abstention, and representation vocabulary in C1 discourse.
